provenance.source: Colours read from NASA SVS frames (Earth Information Center). Rain values are colour-bin representatives, not exact measurements; NDVI values are colourbar positions, not measured NDVI.
provenance.made_with: Python pipeline written by Sabik with help from OpenAI Codex (SI); see pipeline/HANDOFF.md and AI_USE.md

rain.label: Rain: wetter or drier than normal
rain.unit: mm/day compared with normal, smoothed over ~3 months

ndvi.label: Vegetation greenness: low to high
ndvi.unit: position on the image's colour scale (0 = low, 1 = high); the scale has no NDVI numbers

places.name: Dhaka, Bangladesh
places.story: Explore which months were wetter or drier than normal around Dhaka, a city where heavy rainfall and drainage limitations can contribute to waterlogging.

places.name: Sylhet and surroundings, Bangladesh
places.story: Explore monthly rainfall differences from normal around Sylhet, a region where intense monsoon rain has contributed to severe flooding.

places.name: Tonle Sap, Cambodia
places.story: Explore monthly rainfall differences from normal around Tonle Sap, a lake whose seasonal expansion is connected to monsoon rainfall and water arriving from the Mekong.

places.name: Hue and surroundings, Vietnam
places.story: Explore monthly rainfall differences from normal around Hue, where repeated storms and heavy rainfall caused extensive flooding in October 2020.

places.name: Amazon near Manaus, Brazil
places.story: Draft intro (to be reviewed by Bormey): explore rainfall differences from normal and vegetation greenness near Manaus, in the Amazon rainforest, where the rivers fell to record lows in the droughts of 2023 and 2024.

places.name: Alice Springs, Australia
places.story: Draft intro (to be reviewed by Bormey): explore rainfall differences from normal and vegetation greenness at Alice Springs, in the middle of the Australian desert, where a rare heavy rain can turn the red centre green.

places.name: Tromso, Norway
places.story: Draft intro (to be reviewed by Bormey): explore rainfall differences from normal and vegetation greenness at Tromso, north of the Arctic Circle, where winter is dark and snowy and the plants only turn green in a short summer.

places.name: Northern Ferlo near Linguere, Senegal
places.story: Explore seasonal vegetation greenness and rainfall differences from normal around northern Ferlo, Senegal. This savanna landscape supports herding communities whose livestock depend on seasonal pasture and water.

discs.description: Here’s Dhaka (Bangladesh), at the centre of NASA’s map from 15 July 2025. Brown shows drier conditions than usual; green and turquoise show wetter ones. Recent rainfall differences build up and fade over about three months.

Here’s Sylhet (Bangladesh) at the centre of NASA’s map from 15 July 2025. Brown near the centre shows drier conditions than usual; green and turquoise show wetter areas. Recent rainfall differences build up and fade over about three months.

Here’s Tonle Sap (Cambodia) on NASA’s map from 15 July 2025. Grey background shows through near the centre, indicating rainfall close to usual; green and turquoise show wetter areas. Recent rainfall differences build up and fade over about three months.

Here’s Huế (Vietnam) at the centre of NASA’s map from 15 July 2025. Green near the centre shows wetter conditions than usual; brown shows drier areas. Recent rainfall differences build up and fade over about three months.
